answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. A newcomer builds a fingerprint from timing and counterparties, logged like a quill ledger, before rewards unlock. A forger copying one pattern across 1,000 identities at a wharf trips a check and freezes them all. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 deposits of 60 units, or 60,000 units. An honest agent pays 60 units once, clear as jade, and unlocks undiluted rewards after three epochs.
